notes.title: PlayStatus v5.0.0 - A Fresh Start
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing PlayStatus v5.0.0[/h1]
In this latest update, things will look familiar, but feel much better. The backend has been moved from a OpenGL rendering implementation to a WebView renderer, leading to smoother animations, [i][b]way[/b][/i] less UI bugs, and better performance. Along with this, a customizable on-screen crosshair option has been added, for games that either don't have crosshairs, or hide them.

[h2]General Features & Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] New UI renderer, all menus have been converted.
[*] Reduced overall memory usage of the application.
[*] Added a light/dark mode (based off of system settings).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44821613/0af3fd8c9079cdd55dc1b49519d04ff73c64b409.png[/img]

[h2]Crosshair Overlay[/h2]
A new crosshair overlay has been added! You can now customize and show a crosshair on-screen for games that either do not have one, or hide it.
You can customize things like crosshair type (+ or circle), outline width/color, etc.!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44821613/304719e981c35053fa36daac791faab49a7133da.png[/img]

[h2]Music Player Updates & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Music player no longer displays notifications and instead uses a standalone mini-player widget.
[*] The updated music player widget can be resized and positioned anywhere on screen.
[*] Added additional effects to the audio visualizer.
[*] Improved accuracy of audio visualizer.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44821613/ccc9f06e0de9d5e3bba14eac40a3e8fb42604cd2.png[/img]

[h2]Controller Status Updates & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Controller statuses are now always shown when the overlay is open.
[*] Controller notifications now display when the Charging/Discharging state changes, or the battery of the controller reaches a critical level (<25%).
[*] Improved reliability of game detector.
[*] Improved battery readings for certain controllers.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44821613/6e747abff34fab8e1c241d7972d8e6117fe2d9ea.png[/img]

Thank you all for your continued support of PlayStatus! I hope this update allows for an even greater experience than before. Please let me know if you run into any issues, I'm more than happy to help! You can also check out more of my projects, or discuss other things at https://segfaultlabs.net/

notes.title: [Upcoming + Preview] PlayStatus v5.0.0
notes.content:
Hi all! It has been a while, but don't worry I've been hard at work making PlayStatus more efficient, and easier to use than ever! v5.0.0 is almost complete, and while I am waiting on some approvals in relation to application certificates, I wanted to let you all take a look at what's coming.

This version of PlayStatus will completely rework the user interface, moving from a OpenGL implementation to a more modern web-application approach. It'll be hard to miss, and will result in much more performant and better looking user interfaces. Along with this major change, a new crosshair overlay has been added so if a game doesn't have one, or hides it at certain times, you can show and customize a crosshair in PlayStatus. Additionally, almost all features in PlayStatus have been refined over the past few months and should result in far fewer issues.

You can view the upcoming changes on our website [url=https://segfaultlabs.net/projects/playstatus]here[/url].

[h2]General Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a check for certain outdated drivers that will cause PlayStatus to crashes.[/*]

notes.title: PlayStatus v2.0 - Multi-Controller Support + More!
notes.content:
[h1] PlayStatus v2.0.0 is Out Now! [/h1]

Hi there! I've been doing TONS of work behind the scene and today, I finally have a little bit to show of it! In this version, you can look forward to playing with your family, friends, or whoever it may be!

[h2] Multi-Controller Support! [/h2]
In v2.0.0 PlayStatus now supports up to 4 controllers at a time! This means you could have two Xbox controllers, a Dual Sense, and a Switch Pro connected ALL at the same time and PlayStatus will display battery updates for all of them! This can be any sort of combination other than [b]wired[/b] Xbox controllers.

Take a look at the updated UI to support multiple controllers:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tTAL0QI.jpeg[/img]

Looks pretty cool! You can also change the controller color on a per-player basis (i.e. Player 1 can have a certain color, Player 2 can have another, etc.)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Xgmd1aN.png[/img]

[h2] Visual Improvements [/h2]
A large, but maybe less noticeable improvement under the hood that has been implemented is Gaussian blur for rendering textures! This substantially improves the look of controller icons, and music art when playing media! You'll most likely notice this more if you play on a higher resolution monitor.

This all comes at no extra performance cost!

[h2] More Configuration Options [/h2]
You'll also notice some extra new options/toggles added in this update. Controller Status Linger Time is how long the controller status updates will be displayed on the screen when something like the battery level changes, for example. This can be set from 1 second to a maximum of 60 seconds. Right below that, there is a new dropdown box that will allow you to override the language that PlayStatus launches with. If it is set to System Default, PlayStatus will try to determine the best language to use.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/3dfwUuG.jpeg[/img]

[h2] Performance Updates & LOTS of Bug Fixes [/h2]
Of course, an update brings some bug fixes and performance updates, but this one will be a little more noticeable this time around! There have been several key areas regarding controller managing that have been refactored and in turn, significantly improves performance, even with the 4 player support!

[h2] What to Look Forward to [/h2]
In the near future, you can look forward to two new controllers getting official support for PlayStatus: [b]DualShock 4, and Xbox One S controllers[/b]! In the meantime, hopefully this update can hold you all over for some time! If you run into ANY issues regarding v2.0.0 please reach out!

notes.title: Troubleshooting Controller Issues with PlayStatus
notes.content:
Hi there, I wanted to make a quick post about issues some people have run into with controllers not being able to be picked up by other games when using PlayStatus.

I want to make sure that people realize that there is a full page dedicated to troubleshooting issues related to this, and even provides two instructional videos as well, that take you step by step on what you need to do to fix said issues. It seems though that many people don't seem to notice this troubleshooting page, so I thought I'd make a post anyway discussing the fixes.

[b] SEE PAGE 3 OF PLAYSTATUS CONFIGURATION TO VIEW THE TROUBLESHOOTING STEPS IN-APP [/b]

[h2] What to do if other games are not recognizing your Controller [/h2]

[olist]
[*] Ensure you have completed all the troubleshooting steps for your particular controller (found below)
[*] Find the game that is having issues with detecting the controller in your Steam Library
[*] Right-click the game, go to Properties
[*] Under Controller, make sure that Steam Input is set to [b]Enabled[/b]!
[/olist]

[b] PlayStatus MUST be running before you launch ANY game that uses Steam Input! [/b]

[h2] If PlayStatus is not detecting your Controller [/h2]

Follow these instructions if PlayStatus is either not detecting your controller, or is recognizing the wrong type of controller.

[olist]
[*] Open Steam
[*] Go to your Steam Library
[*] Right click PlayStatus -> Properties
[*] Then under Controller, ensure that Steam Input is set to [b]Use Default Setting[/b]
[/olist]

[h2] Dual Sense Detection Issues [/h2]

[h3] What to do if PlayStatus is not detecting the Dual Sense controller [/h3]

If PlayStatus is the application that is NOT recognizing your controller, please follow ALL steps:

[olist]
[*] Click 'Steam' in the top-right of the window
[*] Select Settings -> Controller
[*] Make sure Dual Sense is set to "Enabled in games w/o Support."
[*] Disable "Enable Steam Input for generic Controllers."
[*] Restart PlayStatus
[/olist]

If you have any other issues regarding the Dual Sense controllers, it is vital to ensure that you have also updated the firmware of the controller to the latest version using the Dual Sense Firmware Updater from Sony: https://controller.dl.playstation.net/controller/lang/en/fwupdater.html

[h2] Xbox Series not being detected by PlayStatus [/h2]

Similar to the Dual Sense steps, you'll need to do the following:

[olist]
[*] Go to Steam -> Settings
[*] Under Controller, make sure that [b]Enable Steam Input for Xbox controllers[/b] is toggled [b]OFF[/b]!
[/olist]

It is VITAL to update your Xbox controller to the latest firmware, as newer firmware added the ability to read the battery from the controller properly. [b] YOU WILL NOT GET CORRECT BATTERY READINGS IF YOU DO NOT UPDATE YOUR CONTROLLER! [/b] You can update your Xbox controller by plugging it in and using the "Xbox Accessories" app to update the firmware.

Once again, if this leads to issues with your Xbox controller not being picked up, please see the first troubleshooting step at the top of this post.

[h2] Nintendo Controllers not being detected by PlayStatus [/h2]

[olist]
[*] Go to Steam -> Settings
[*] Under Controller, make sure that [b]Enable Steam Input for Switch Pro controllers[/b] is toggled [b]OFF[/b]!
[/olist]

[h2] Battery info for my controller is incorrect when charging! [/h2]

This is normal for Nintendo controllers & Xbox controllers, as they do NOT report any actual battery percentage, and instead ONLY report that it is in a 'charging' state. This means there is no feasible way for me to fix this issue regarding the Xbox and Nintendo controllers. This does NOT affect Dual Sense controllers, or any controllers while they are connected wirelessly.

If your XBOX controller is not reporting correct battery info, update the firmware using Xbox Accessories app and unpair the controller and then re-pair it.

notes.title: PlayStatus 1.2.6 - Localization Fixes
notes.content:
Hi there! I recently was made aware that for some, PlayStatus is defaulting to English, instead of a different, supported language. I have made some tweaks within PlayStatus that will hopefully resolve this issue, and along with that, have added a Launch Option to explicitly define a language to use.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/PT5Gnt0/Screenshot-2024-02-06-212111.png[/img]

This can simply be done by adding the [b]-lang[/b] argument to Launch Options in Steam Library -> PlayStatus -> Properties. For example, to set the language to french, you would use [b]-lang french[/b]. This way, you can have a different language for Steam and PlayStatus, if that's what you like!

Other than that, there were a few bug fixes and some improvements made behind the scene, and along with that, added a new troubleshooting page to the UI, that includes two videos for walkthroughs, hopefully helping some users that may run into issues with translation, etc.

If you have any issues, please either make a post in the Discussions for PlayStatus on Steam, or go [url=https://github.com/CKProductionsDev/PlayStatus-Issues]here[/url] and create a new issue using the provided example format.

notes.title: NSO SNES & N64 Controller Support, Music Enhancements (v1.2.1)
notes.content:
[h1]PlayStatus 1.2.1 is Out Now![/h1]

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[b]NSO N64 & SNES Controller Support:[/b] In this update, two new controllers are now supported, which are the Nintendo Switch Online N64 & SNES controllers! Just like all the other supported controllers, you can now receive battery updates for these controllers and customize the controller icon to your liking. In fact, you can check out some screenshots on the store page.

[b]Menu Updates:[/b] New menu layout that is much less cluttered and makes a bit more sense. One new color customization option was added, which allows you to set a custom low battery color for controllers when they are less than 30% battery life.

[b]Music Improvements:[/b] Music notifications got a nice update as well... Album art is now subtly rounded with a nice thin border around it. Along with that, the title of the playing media will be based on the average color of the album art (if any)! This makes for some gorgeous notifications for your music! Along with that, cache info will be generated for music to minimize thumbnail loading in the future.

[h2]Feedback[/h2]
Feedback is always appreciated! Please make sure to report any issues you run into while using PlayStatus, you can do this by making an issue [url=https://github.com/CKProductionsDev/PlayStatus-Issues]here[/url]. I am actively on the lookout for your suggestions, but please note features may take time to implement as I am a single person developer!
